lines.text: The trip is canceled? What a bummer.

data.define: Used when something is a bit sad or disappointing.

example.text: The trip is canceled? What a bummer.

misuse.text: Don't say 'bummer' to someone who lost a loved one.
misuse.why: It's too light for deep grief.
